name: needle
description: 14MB foundation model for tiny devices; phones, wearables, smart home, and robots.
readme_excerpt: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use and structured extraction. The whole model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on our Simple Attention Network findings, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine. On the benchmarks below, Needle 2 trades wins with other small models like FunctionGemma 270M, LFM2.5 230M and Apple FM, at 5x to 70x smaller, and 2 bits against their f16.

name: Switchyard
description: Switchyard lets LLM applications route traffic across models and providers while preserving native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility - enabling flexible model selection, benchmarking, and cost/performance optimization.
readme_excerpt: Switchyard is a Rust proxy and library for LLM traffic. It routes requests across providers, translates between OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, records operational metrics, and provides typed, composable routing algorithms.

name: ai-memory
description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
readme_excerpt: LLM coding agents lose context when a session ends. ai-memory gives them a shared, persistent wiki compiled from sanitized lifecycle observations. When a session ends, relevant observations become a coherent summary; the next agent receives a bounded handoff. Optional ai-memory run launches add a portable visible-event ledger and native per-harness resume for higher-fidelity cross-harness continuity.
